title: Stereotype and Skew: Quantifying Gender Bias in Pre-trained and Fine-tuned Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Masking pronouns in the WinoBias dataset and comparing the language model's prediction probabilities for male vs. female pronouns across pro-stereotypical and anti-stereotypical occupational sentences. The paper calculates F1 score disparities to formulate two specific metrics: 'skew' (general preference for male or female pronouns) and 'stereotype' (preference based on professional stereotypes). It also evaluates gender bias through manual annotation to measure pronoun resolution shifts based on the perceived competency of the sentence's subject.
